name: immediately-run
description: Create interactive apps, visual explanations, and Grove reports, then publish and verify them on immediately.run.

interface.longDescription: Create interactive visual explanations, simulations, and custom React apps, or turn research and data into themed Grove reports. Publish source to a GitHub repository and verify the reading experience on immediately.run. Choose an interactive app when controls and exploration are central, or a Grove report when prose, sections, charts, and cards lead. Includes guidance for sandbox-safe styles and assets, public Pages caching, existing repositories, and private access. Requires a code execution environment with the relevant project tools; publication requires the user's authorized GitHub access. Browser tools are needed for live render verification. This skills-only plugin does not include a hosted backend or MCP server and does not itself grant GitHub or immediately.run permissions.
defaultPrompt: Explain Fourier series with interactive visuals in an immediately.run app.
Turn my research and data into a Grove report for immediately.run.
Publish this project to my chosen GitHub repository and check its immediately.run link.

prompts: Explain Fourier series with sliders for harmonic count in an immediately.run app. Keep it local.
Turn these quarterly support figures into a Grove report for immediately.run with a summary and charts.
Publish this immediately.run app to a new public repository under my GitHub account.
Update this existing private immediately.run repository and preserve its current branch and visibility.
My React app works in Vite but has unreadable colors and missing fonts on immediately.run. Diagnose and fix it.

publication.release_notes: Adds an interactive React-artifact skill, Codex skill metadata, shared publication guidance, sandbox styling and asset checks, and a portable plugin package while preserving Grove and existing agent integrations.
